How we Hire

We believe that recruiting is a mutual evaluation, and should be transparent, fair, and respectful of your time.

Step 1

Apply

Apply for your dream position and send your CV our way.

Step 2

Profile Screening

The hiring team will review your application and let you know if there’s a potential fit.

Step 3

2-4 Interviews

Meet your future manager and colleagues for professional and peer interviews.

Step 4

HR

It’s all about the culture & people, this is the chance to get to know each other better!

Step 5

Offer

You did it! Our offer is headed your way. You’re one signature away from becoming a Komodorian!
